pr.title: test(adhd): prove dashboard state wiring
pr.body:
## Problem
The ADHD dashboard UI depends on a live signal path from synthetic state changes through /ws/state into the realtime cognitive band, but the current queue item needs a deterministic anti-regression test for that wiring.

## Fix
- Add a backend test that patches live Redis readers and proves a synthetic state_update broadcast reaches the real /ws/state route.
- Export the frontend realtime mapper for testability.
- Add a frontend test proving the same state_update shape maps into critical UI-band state values.

## Test Plan
- Validate Task Packet JSON and schema.
- Run the focused backend WebSocket test.
- Run the focused frontend mapper test and UI build.
- Run git diff --check and pre-commit on changed files.

steps.task: Trace dashboard state flow from Redis state-change broadcast through /ws/state and frontend realtime mapping.
requirements: Identify the backend that owns /api/adhd-state and /ws/state.
Confirm no live Redis or ADHD Engine calls are required for the test.
Confirm the frontend state_update mapping drives the cognitive status/load band.

steps.task: Add deterministic anti-regression tests for backend WebSocket broadcast and frontend realtime mapping.
requirements: Backend test must use the real /ws/state route and patch background Redis readers to inert coroutines.
Frontend test must use the same state_update message shape as the backend broadcast path.
Frontend code change must be limited to exporting the mapper needed by the test.

steps.task: Run packet validation, focused backend/frontend checks, codereview/precommit, commit, push, PR, and update Task Orchestrator with proof.
requirements: Report live Redis, ADHD Engine, and browser runtime as NOT_RUN unless explicitly exercised.
